name: devhub
description: Jira, Figma, Sentry and Grafana in one sidebar, keyed off the branch you're on.

viewsWelcome.contents:
No ticket for this branch yet.

DevHub reads a ticket key such as PROJ-1234 out of your branch name.

[Pin a ticket](command:devhub.pinTicket)
[Start work on an issue](command:devhub.startWork)

Not connected to Jira yet?
[Connect a service](command:devhub.signIn)

devhub.ticketKeyPattern.markdownDescription: Regular expression used to find a ticket key in the branch name or last commit message.

devhub.branchTemplate.markdownDescription: Branch name template for `Start work on issue`. Supports `${key}`, `${slug}`, `${type}`.

devhub.jira.email.description: Atlassian account email, paired with the API token you enter via Connect a service.

devhub.jira.jql.default: assignee = currentUser() AND statusCategory != Done ORDER BY updated DESC
devhub.jira.jql.description: JQL used for the issue picker and the fallback list when no ticket is detected.

devhub.jira.tasksJql.default: assignee = currentUser() AND (statusCategory != Done OR resolutiondate >= -14d) ORDER BY updated DESC
devhub.jira.tasksJql.markdownDescription: JQL behind the **My tasks** view. Whatever this returns is what the status filter can choose from, so widen it to filter over more statuses. Ordering is applied in the view, not by this query.

devhub.jira.inProgressTransition.markdownDescription: Name of the transition (or the status it moves to) to offer after `Start work on issue`. Leave empty to match "In progress", "Start" or "Doing" automatically.

devhub.jira.tasksLimit.description: Maximum number of assigned tasks to fetch for the My tasks view.

devhub.tasks.promptTemplate.markdownDescription: Text copied by the clipboard button on a row in **My tasks**. Placeholders: `${url}`, `${key}`, `${summary}`, `${type}`, `${status}`. Leave empty to use the built-in two-stage investigate-then-implement prompt. Run **DevHub: Edit copy prompt…** to open this filled in with the prompt in use, rather than editing it from blank.

devhub.sentry.baseUrl.description: Sentry base URL. Change this for a self-hosted instance.

devhub.sentry.organization.markdownDescription: Sentry organization slug — the `acme` in `https://acme.sentry.io`. Pasting the full organization URL works too; the slug is taken out of it.

devhub.sentry.environment.markdownDescription: Restrict Sentry queries to one environment, for example `production`. Empty means all environments.

devhub.sentry.pathMappings.markdownDescription: Rewrites applied to stack frame filenames before resolving them against the workspace root.

devhub.sentry.diagnostics.description: Show production errors as warnings in the Problems panel.

devhub.sentry.codeLens.description: Show event counts above lines that appear in production stack traces.

devhub.figma.enabled.description: Render Figma frames linked from the ticket.

devhub.github.enabled.description: Show pull requests for the current branch, your open pull requests, and the ones awaiting your review.

devhub.github.baseUrl.markdownDescription: GitHub REST base URL. For GitHub Enterprise use `https://your-host/api/v3`; the GraphQL endpoint and the remote host to match are derived from it.

devhub.github.limit.description: Maximum pull requests to fetch per queue.

devhub.github.reviewPromptTemplate.markdownDescription: Text copied by the clipboard button on a row in **Awaiting my review**. Placeholders: `${url}`, `${repo}`, `${number}`, `${title}`, `${author}`, `${key}` (the ticket key found in the pull request title, empty if there is none). Leave empty to use the built-in review prompt. Run **DevHub: Edit copy prompt…** to open this filled in with the prompt in use, rather than editing it from blank.

devhub.github.updatePromptTemplate.markdownDescription: Text copied by the clipboard button on a row in **My open pull requests**. Placeholders: `${url}`, `${repo}`, `${number}`, `${title}`, `${state}` (what the row says is blocking it, such as `Conflicts · Changes requested · Checks failing`), `${key}` (the ticket key found in the pull request title, empty if there is none). Leave empty to use the built-in prompt that reads the review threads, the diff and the failing checks, then addresses them. Run **DevHub: Edit copy prompt…** to open this filled in with the prompt in use, rather than editing it from blank.

devhub.statusBar.enabled.description: Show the current ticket in the status bar.

devhub.rows.titleLength.markdownDescription: Characters a task or pull request title may take in a row before it is shortened, so the rest of the row — the age, the repository, the review state — stays visible. The full title is always in the row's tooltip. Set to `0` to never shorten.

devhub.refresh.minIntervalSeconds.markdownDescription: Shortest gap between background refreshes of Jira, GitHub, Sentry, Figma and Grafana. Window focus, saves and Git state events all trigger a refresh, so this is the floor that keeps them from becoming requests. A branch switch and **DevHub: Refresh** ignore it. Set to `0` to refresh on every trigger.

devhub.grafana.enabled.description: Show Grafana alerts and endpoint latency.

devhub.grafana.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Grafana base URL, e.g. `https://acme.grafana.net`. Asked for when you connect Grafana.

devhub.grafana.services.markdownDescription: Maps a repository name to the PromQL label selector that identifies its service, e.g. `{ "acme-web": "service=web, env=prod" }`. Only equality matchers are supported. Unmapped repositories fall back to matching the repository name against `#devhub.grafana.serviceLabels#`.

devhub.grafana.serviceLabels.markdownDescription: Label names to match a repository name against when it has no entry in `#devhub.grafana.services#`. The first one is also used to build the latency query selector.

devhub.grafana.latency.datasourceUid.markdownDescription: UID of the Prometheus datasource to run the latency query against. Find it in the datasource URL in Grafana. Without this, the Slowest endpoints group stays empty.

devhub.grafana.latency.datasourceKind.markdownDescription: Which query language `#devhub.grafana.latency.query#` is written in. `prometheus` for PromQL against metrics, `loki` for LogQL against access logs. **DevHub: Set up latency query…** sets this for you.

devhub.grafana.latency.query.markdownDescription: PromQL for the slowest endpoints. `${selector}`, `${window}`, `${limit}` and `${service}` are filled in; an unrecognised placeholder is left as written. Leave empty for the built-in p95-per-route query.

devhub.grafana.latency.window.markdownDescription: Range the latency query looks back over, as a PromQL duration such as `15m`, `1h` or `24h`.

languageModelTools.name: devhub_getTicket
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns the Jira issue for the branch the user is currently on, including summary, description, acceptance criteria, status and subtasks. Call this before implementing a feature or fix so the work matches what the ticket actually asks for.

key.description: Optional issue key such as PROJ-1234. Defaults to the ticket detected from the current branch.

languageModelTools.name: devhub_getErrors
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns unresolved Sentry issues affecting the files changed on the current branch, with the culprit, event count, affected user count and the top stack frames of the latest event.

query.description: Optional Sentry search query. Defaults to unresolved issues touching the current diff.

languageModelTools.name: devhub_getDesign
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns the Figma frames linked from the current ticket, including frame names, dimensions, layer structure and the colour and typography values used, so generated UI matches the design.

url.description: Optional Figma frame URL. Defaults to the frames linked from the current ticket.

languageModelTools.name: devhub_getAlerts
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns the Grafana alerts firing for the service the current repository maps to, with severity, labels and how long each has been active, plus the slowest endpoints by p95 latency. Call this to check whether a change is degrading the service, or before investigating a performance complaint.

includeLatency.description: Include the slowest-endpoints query. Defaults to true.
